name: Average Daily Traffic Counts
rowLabel: Daily Count for a Street Segment

columns.name: timestamp
columns.description: Date associated with the count

columns.name: segmentid
columns.description: Identification number for the segment in the Automated Traffic Management System (ATMS)

columns.name: roadname
columns.description: Name of the road where the segment is located

columns.name: direction
columns.description: Direction of travel along the segment

columns.name: fromsegment
columns.description: Intersection where the segment begins

columns.name: tosegment
columns.description: Intersection where the segment ends

columns.name: vehiclecount
columns.description: Average daily traffic count of vehicles traveling along the segment (30-day average)

columns.name: startlat
columns.description: Latitude of the start point of the segment

columns.name: startlon
columns.description: Longitude of the start point of the segment

columns.name: startlocation
columns.description: Location of the start point of the segment in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal.

columns.name: midpointlat
columns.description: Latitude of the midpoint of the segment

columns.name: midpointlon
columns.description: Longitude of the midpoint of the segment

columns.name: midpointlocation
columns.description: Location of the midpoint of the segment in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal.

columns.name: endlat
columns.description: Latitude of the endpoint of the segment

columns.name: endlon
columns.description: Longitude of the endpoint of the segment

columns.name: endlocation
columns.description: Location of the endpoint of the segment in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal.

columns.name: recordid
columns.description: A unique identifier for the row.

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'midpoint_location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
